name: Conditional Value
description: Per-row conditional. If the input value is NA (missing), output the alternate value; else output the configured base value (default 0).

formula.notes: base='value' turns the expression into coalesce(value, alternate) and preserves the input type, so it is usable on dates as well as numbers.

configurations.name: base
configurations.description: Value emitted when value is present. A number masks the row with that constant (the existing behaviour). The literal 'value' emits value itself, making the method a coalesce: take value, fall back to alternate.

output_classes.description: alternate when value is NA, else base

input_roles.name: value
input_roles.description: The value tested for presence. Evaluated numerically when base is a number; with base='value' the method only passes it through, so the input keeps whatever type it has — this is how the coalesce form works on dates.

input_roles.name: alternate
input_roles.description: The fallback emitted when value is missing. Same type as value.
